about_the_game:
Frutiger Space is currently undergoing active development, and much of what you see is still a work in progress. If something feels incomplete or out of place, rest assured that it’s either being improved or will be addressed in upcoming updates!

An Overview

Frutiger Space is a social multiplayer game set in a nostalgic yet futuristic world, inspired by the aesthetics of the golden age of the internet. Whether you're exploring, playing minigames, customizing your Meeple, discovering secrets, or simply vibing to music while floating in a bubble, there's always something to do!

Chat with Friends

Frutiger Space captures the spirit of early internet social games, offering you a proper space to chat with old friends, make new ones, and be part of a warm and welcoming community!

A World of Frutiger Subgenres

Each island has its own distinct aesthetic, drawing inspiration from various internet-era trends, such as Frutiger Eco, Frutiger Aqua, Frutiger Metro, Technozen and much more!

Meeple Customization

Your Meeple is customizable with a wide selection of cosmetics. Express yourself with unique outfits, stylish hats, and accessories. You can shop for new items using Frutiger Orbs, earned by exploring, playing minigames, or just exploring the world.

Activities and Minigames

The game features a variety of minigames and activities, of course, no grinding and no sweating, including:

  • Dolphin Racing

  • Rhythm Games

  • Ice Fishing

  • Watergun Battles

  • Fruit Collecting

  • Painting Battles

  • And much more to come!
